name: kmeans-wasm-workspace
description: Development and release tooling for the kmeans-wasm npm package.

scripts.build: node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => fs.rmSync('pkg', { recursive: true, force: true }))" && wasm-pack build --release --target web --out-dir pkg && node scripts/finalize-npm-package.mjs pkg
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && cargo check --locked --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --tests && npm run package:check && npm run pages:build && npm run test:page
scripts.package:check: npm run build && publint --strict pkg && attw --pack --profile esm-only pkg && node scripts/test-package.mjs
